2793-3743-5089-7824-8242.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-7824-8242.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Songbird by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with eight or more +1/+1 counters on it
attached to any creature you control except Sekki

728-1475-1724.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sekki
When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2146-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1643-2073-2292-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

719-4302-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-4302-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3532-3835-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3835-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

423-1313-1437-3147.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1313-1437-3147.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2079-3259-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
2079-3259-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7156.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1395-5078-5231-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

11-1927-2365-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-2365-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Expropriate.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Expropriate spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Expropriate spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Expropriate and returning the original Expropriate to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Expropriate from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

997-3912-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1651-2392-4702-4891.description:
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat

2099-3661-5220-6900.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

104-4186-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-6752.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1-4444-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-4444-5796-6282.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

4365-5636-5742-5743.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2584-4050-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Soul Collector, adding one mana of any color.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

3487-4374-5663.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3487-4374-5663.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability and Aetherstorm Roc trigger.
Resolve the Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Aethergeode Miner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

2084-4795.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two untapped creatures.
2084-4795.description:
Activate Dermotaxi by tapping two creatures you control, causing it to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate Dermotaxi by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Dermotaxi into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2713-3076-4289-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
2713-3076-4289-4639.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sleep-Cursed Faerie triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-2762-4434-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
643-2762-4434-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield as a Treefolk due to Maskwood Nexus, Quickbeam triggers, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2059-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2059-3337.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

678-4050-5221.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sprouting Thrinax, adding {B}.
Sprouting Thrinax dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {R}{G}.
Cast Sprouting Thrinax by paying {B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

3263-3746-4170-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater that entered the battlefield this turn.
3263-3746-4170-4747.description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Alena's ability by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Fain's fourth ability by paying {4}, untapping Robaran Mercenaries.
Repeat.

600-1124-3334.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of each of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Cast Jace by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Jace enters the battlefield with four loyalty counters due to Lae'zel.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing you to loot whenever you deal combat damage to a player this turn.
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two non-legendary copies of Jace, which enter with four loyalty counters each due to Lae'zel.
Repeat from step 4 using a Jace token.
Once you have infinite Jace tokens, you may activate their second loyalty abilities by removing two loyalty counters from them, creating infinite 2/2 Illusion creature tokens.

3492-3609-4874.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper and Bishop of Rebirth do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block and kill Bishop of Rebirth.
3492-3609-4874.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Declare Bishop of Rebirth as an attacker.
Bishop of Rebirth triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
